ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In the diagram of the food web shown, what does the bengal tiger consume directly?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the food web there is a box labeled "Bengal Tiger", located at the upper left. Below it and slightly to the left there is a "Sumatran Rhino" box, and there is an arrow pointing from "Sumatran Rhino" to "Bengal Tiger". Reasoning: In a food web, arrows usually point from the food/prey that is eaten to the predator/consumer. Therefore, the source that points directly to Bengal Tiger indicates the organism it directly consumes, so Bengal Tiger directly consumes Sumatran Rhino.
